name: transcend-agent-governance
description: Connect Cursor to Transcend Agent Governance for policy-enforced MCP tool access.

GATEWAY_BASE_URL.title: Gateway base URL
GATEWAY_BASE_URL.description: HTTPS base URL of your organization's Agent Governance MCP gateway (scheme + host only; no path). Copy it from the Connect Cursor panel in the Agent Governance dashboard. Do not append /mcp/... — the plugin adds that.

TENANT_ID.title: Tenant ID
TENANT_ID.description: Your Agent Governance tenant (organization) identifier. Shown in the Connect Cursor panel next to the gateway URL.

CREDENTIAL.title: Credential
CREDENTIAL.description: Bound API key for the connected agent (preferred), or a machine access token. Create it in the Agent Governance dashboard under the agent's Connect Cursor / credentials flow — the secret is shown once. Prefer an API key: machine JWTs expire in about one hour and do not refresh.
